groomingVideos.title: Mastering Coat Brushing & Undercoat De-Shedding
groomingVideos.description: Learn professional brushing techniques for double coats, long furs, and curly hair. Avoid painful hair pulling while boosting natural sheen.

groomingVideos.title: Stress-Free Gentle Pet Bathing & Skin Care Routine
groomingVideos.description: Keep bath time calm and soothing. Covers water temperature calibration, tearless shampoo application, ear protection, and fluff drying.

groomingVideos.title: Safe Nail Trimming & Paw Care for Dogs & Cats
groomingVideos.description: How to identify the quick, use safety-stop clippers or rotary grinders, and keep your furry companion completely calm with positive reinforcement.
steps: Locate the pink blood vessel quick
Smooth rough edges with rotary file

groomingVideos.title: Canine & Feline Dental Hygiene & Tooth Brushing
groomingVideos.description: Prevent periodontal disease and freshen pet breath with enzymatic poultry/malt toothpaste and finger-brush introduction methods.

healthTips.title: Oral Care & Periodontal Prevention
healthTips.summary: 80% of dogs show signs of periodontal disease by age 3. Daily enzymatic brushing and dental chews can extend pet lifespan by up to 3-5 years.

healthTips.title: Weight Management & Body Condition Scoring
healthTips.summary: Maintaining an ideal Body Condition Score (4-5 on a 9-point scale) prevents chronic osteoarthritis, feline diabetes, and cardiac stress.
checklist: Feel ribs easily without excess fat layer
Visible waistline when viewed from above

healthTips.title: Recognizing Early Warning Signs of Illness
healthTips.summary: Pets instinctively mask pain. Learn the subtle behavioral shifts such as litter box avoidance, excessive water drinking, or subtle gait imbalances.
checklist: Check gum color (should be healthy salmon pink)

trainingTips.title: Positive Reinforcement & Clicker Foundation
trainingTips.description: Timing is everything. Pair the distinct 'click' sound within 0.8 seconds of the desired behavior followed immediately by a high-value treat.
steps: Click when pet offers eye contact
Introduce cue word after behavior is consistent

trainingTips.title: Mastering Loose Leash Walking
trainingTips.description: Transform stressful lunging walks into peaceful bonding strolls with the 'Red Light / Green Light' reverse direction technique.
steps: Walk forward the instant leash goes slack
Reward heel position next to your leg

trainingTips.title: Foolproof Potty Training & Crate Conditioning
trainingTips.description: Establish clear 2-hour biological rhythms. The crate is never a punishment—it is a safe, cozy den that mirrors natural instincts.
steps: Take puppy outside 15 min after eating
Never scold accidents after the fact

trainingTips.title: Desensitization & Calming Anxious Pets
trainingTips.description: Help pets overcome fear of thunder, fireworks, or doorbells through low-volume acoustic counter-conditioning.
steps: Play trigger sounds at very low volume
Feed favorite snacks during sound playback
Keep your own energy calm and grounded

puppy.title: Puppies & Kittens (0 - 12 Months)
puppy.waterGuideline: ½ cup per pound of body weight daily
puppy.notes: Rich in DHA for brain and retinal development. Maintain strict meal times to aid house-training.

adult.title: Adult Pets (1 - 7 Years)
adult.waterGuideline: 1 ounce of water per pound of body weight daily
adult.notes: Prevent obesity by measuring portions accurately. Combine dry kibble with quality wet food for hydration.
